CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_effective_payout_depth(p_depth numeric, p_legacy_percent smallint)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(p_depth, p_legacy_percent::numeric, 12.5);
$function$
